components.name: DS Bot Whale Mark
components.description: DS Bot's Apache-2.0 whale character, used as the Task=Bot silhouette in the featured card, task rows, and collapsed brand.
components.css: .ds-task-mark { display:grid; width:36px; height:36px; place-items:center; border-radius:11px; color:var(--blue,#4d6bfe); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 10%,var(--paper,#fff)); } .ds-task-mark svg { width:34px; height:34px; }

components.name: Task Rail Row
components.description: Bot-shaped durable task context with title, goal, unread signal, and neutral active state.
components.css: .ds-task-row { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:54px; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px; border:0; border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink,#141414); background:transparent; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-task-row:hover { background:rgba(119,119,119,.09); } .ds-task-row.ds-is-active { background:rgba(119,119,119,.17); } .ds-task-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-row-mark { display:grid; width:36px; height:36px; flex:none; place-items:center; border-radius:11px; color:var(--blue,#4d6bfe); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 10%,var(--paper,#fff)); } .ds-row-mark svg { width:34px; height:34px; } .ds-row-copy { display:flex; min-width:0; flex:1; flex-direction:column; } .ds-row-copy strong,.ds-row-copy small { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-row-copy strong { font:500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-row-copy small { color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); font:400 13px/18px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-task-row i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--blue,#4d6bfe); }

components.name: Round Utility Button
components.description: Shared 20×20 DS Bot icon geometry inside a restrained circular shell.
components.html: <button class="ds-round" aria-label="New task"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.5v13M3.5 10h13"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-round { display:grid; width:36px; height:36px; padding:0; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08); border-radius:50%; color:var(--ink,#141414); background:var(--canvas,#fcfcfc); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms ease,transform 120ms ease; } .ds-round svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-round:hover { background:rgba(119,119,119,.09); } .ds-round:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-round:active { transform:scale(.94); }

components.name: Pegas Message
components.description: Avatar-free Pegas response bubble with metadata and contextual actions below.
components.html:
I've organized this into a durable task and started the first step.
21:07
components.css: .ds-pegas-message { max-width:760px; color:var(--ink,#141414); font:400 14px/24px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-pegas-message>div { padding:7px 12px; border-radius:18px; background:var(--bubble,#eeeeee); } .ds-pegas-message footer { display:flex; min-height:22px; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:rgba(20,20,20,.36); font-size:11px; line-height:14px; } .ds-pegas-message button { margin-left:auto; border:0; border-radius:6px; color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); background:transparent; opacity:0; } .ds-pegas-message:hover button,.ds-pegas-message:focus-within button { opacity:1; } .ds-pegas-message button:hover { color:var(--ink,#141414); background:rgba(119,119,119,.09); } .ds-pegas-message button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; opacity:1; }

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: 48px capsule with attachment on the left and voice/send actions on the right.
components.html: <form class="ds-composer"><button class="ds-composer-utility" aria-label="Attach">+</button><textarea aria-label="Message" placeholder="Message this task"></textarea><button class="ds-composer-primary" aria-label="Voice">•••</button></form>
components.css: .ds-composer { display:flex; width:min(992px,100%); min-height:48px; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius:24px; background:var(--paper,#fff); box-shadow:0 8px 28px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.08),0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.04); } .ds-composer:hover,.ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:rgba(20,20,20,.3); } .ds-composer textarea { min-width:0; min-height:24px; flex:1; padding:0; border:0; outline:0; resize:none; color:var(--ink,#141414); background:transparent; font:400 14px/24px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-composer button { display:grid; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:50%; cursor:pointer; } .ds-composer-utility { color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); background:rgba(20,20,20,.05); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .5px rgba(20,20,20,.08); } .ds-composer-primary { color:#fff; background:var(--blue,#4d6bfe); } .ds-composer button:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-composer button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Collapsed Workspace Tab
components.description: Default right-rail affordance that keeps inspection available without consuming conversation width.
components.css: .ds-workspace-tab { display:flex; width:36px; min-width:36px; height:112px; min-height:112px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 0; border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08); border-radius:18px; color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); background:var(--paper,#fff); writing-mode:vertical-rl; cursor:pointer; } .ds-workspace-tab svg { width:16px; height:16px; flex:none; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-workspace-tab:hover { color:var(--ink,#141414); background:var(--panel,#f7f7f7); } .ds-workspace-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Settings Group
components.description: Grouped configuration rows inside the settings modal, with blue-soft selected state.
components.css: .ds-settings-group { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.15); border-radius:12px; background:var(--paper,#fff); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,20,.04); } .ds-setting { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:12px 16px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08); color:var(--ink,#141414); background:transparent; font:500 13px/18px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-setting:last-child { border-bottom:0; } .ds-setting small { color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); font-weight:400; } .ds-setting:hover { background:rgba(119,119,119,.09); } .ds-setting.ds-is-selected { background:var(--blue-soft,#eef1ff); } .ds-setting:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Plugin Card
components.description: Catalog card with DS Bot plug geometry, concise description, and service-owned status.
components.css: .ds-plugin-card { display:grid; min-height:100px; grid-template-columns:42px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:start; gap:12px; padding:16px; border:1px solid rgba(20,20,20,.08); border-radius:14px; color:var(--ink,#141414); background:var(--paper,#fff); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-plugin-card:hover { border-color:rgba(20,20,20,.15); background:var(--panel,#f7f7f7); } .ds-plugin-card:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--blue,#4d6bfe) 46%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-plugin-mark { display:grid; width:42px; height:42px; place-items:center; border-radius:13px; color:var(--blue,#4d6bfe); background:var(--blue-soft,#eef1ff); } .ds-plugin-mark svg { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-plugin-card strong,.ds-plugin-card small { display:block; } .ds-plugin-card strong { font:600 14px/20px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-plugin-card small { margin-top:5px; color:rgba(20,20,20,.62); font:400 12px/18px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-plugin-card em { grid-column:2; color:#666; font:normal 11px/14px 'Inter Variable',Inter,sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The current Pegas interface adopts DS Bot as its interaction and visual identity while keeping the Pegas name, service boundary, and domain behavior. This is an implementation contract, not a loose source of inspiration. Its defining model is Task = Bot: each durable task is represented as a DS Bot character in the left rail, and selecting that item changes the conversation context rather than opening a disconnected dashboard.

The product should feel like a focused work desk with three stable zones: tasks on the left, conversation in the center, and inspectable output on the right. The right workspace remains collapsed by default so dialogue has priority; settings and plugins temporarily rise above the shell as modal layers. The visual language stays neutral, compact, and operational, with Pegas blue reserved for bot geometry, active signals, progress, and decisive actions.
keyCharacteristics: Task-as-Bot identity expressed through DS Bot's whale character and icon geometry.
280px expanded task rail and 56px collapsed task rail.
Centered conversation flow capped at 960px, with a 48px capsule composer.
Right workspace represented by a narrow collapsed tab until inspection is requested.
Settings, plugin catalog, and plugin detail presented as progressively deeper modal layers.
DS Bot interaction and visual identity applied consistently to Pegas-owned tasks, messages, settings, plugins, and workspaces.

rules.name: The Bot Signal Rule
rules.body: Pegas blue belongs to bot geometry, current state, progress, focus, and primary action; it is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Neutral Shell Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with canvas, paper, panel, bubble, and line tones before adding color or elevation.

rules.name: The Message Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Dialogue owns the roomiest line height; rail and modal chrome must remain visually quieter than the message content.

rules.name: The Inspect-on-Demand Rule
rules.body: Keep conversation flat and dominant; elevation appears only when a control, workspace, or configuration layer temporarily moves above it.

dos: Do treat each durable Task as a bot-shaped conversation context, not merely a dashboard row.
Do preserve the 280px expanded and 56px collapsed task-rail states.
Do keep the conversation flow at or below 960px and the composer at a 48px minimum height.
Do keep the right workspace collapsed by default and reveal inspection depth on demand.
Do use the 20×20, 1.6px rounded DS Bot icon geometry consistently for supporting controls.
Do keep settings, plugin catalog, and plugin detail as clearly ordered modal layers.
Do preserve modal focus trapping, Escape dismissal, inert backgrounds, and trigger-focus restoration at every layer.
donts: Don't revert mobile navigation to a top bar; the current shell preserves the 56px task rail.
Don't expose the workspace as a permanent wide panel when the user has not requested inspection.
Don't replace Task=Bot with a generic card board, chat list, or disconnected task dashboard.
Don't use Pegas blue as ambient decoration or a broad background field.
Don't mix unrelated icon families, stroke weights, or sharp-cornered glyph geometry into the DS Bot shell.
Don't let modal detail layers obscure their close action, scroll boundary, or service-owned configuration boundary.
